clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock Blockade is an Alliance military task issued by Marshal Marris in Lakeshire. Confronting the encroaching Blackrock orcs east of Lake Everstill, the town guard aims to starve out the invaders and seize their weaponry.

While the Blackrock clan has made bold incursions into the Redridge Mountains, their brazen push into Alliance territory has stretched their logistics to a breaking point. Cut off from regular supply trains, their forward war parties are forced to live off the harsh Redridge hills. Marshal Marris recognizes that even ferocious orcs cannot sustain a campaign without steady provisions and steel.

The orcish camps situated south of Stonewatch Keep represent the spearhead of the Blackrock offensive. By raiding these encampments, stripping their caches, and seizing their stolen weapons, Alliance defenders hope to cripple the vanguard's fighting strength and break their morale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You can't fight a war without weapons.
Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.
Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.
We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
